g.text: Both models use target-assay development labels. Baseline: saved mutation-additive regression on the same test partitions.

text.style: font-size: 10.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5f6872

g.text: Mean of 2 seeds; descriptive, with overlapping test identities. Previously inspected retrospective tests; no prospective validation.

text.style: font-size: 10.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5f6872

g.text: Top-5% positives include boundary ties. 24 picks can recover every positive only when the positive set has 24 or fewer variants.

text.style: font-size: 10.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5f6872

g.text: CR9114/FluB: every test variant qualifies because of assay-floor ties; both recalls are 4.7% and enrichment is 1.0x.

text.style: font-size: 10.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5f6872

g.text: Sources: multifamily/benchmark_summary.csv and benchmark_runs.csv. Continuous Spearman uses scores before floor clipping.
